diagnosis: Rollout 2 and 3 both passed Check C4 because they recorded signed waivers (Fact PF2), even though neither of these rollouts had access to Fact PF2. This indicates that Check C4 is overly permissive, as it allows the recording of waivers without requiring the presence of the relevant agent (A3).
